in_marathi.name: Kameshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kameshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Desire and Pleasure. Kame means desire and Shwari means the fulfiller. Worshipped as the goddess of love and fertility.

in_bengali.name: Kameshwari
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Desire
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kameshwari একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of Desire and Pleasure. Kame means desire and Shwari means the fulfiller. Worshipped as the goddess of love and fertility.
